items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: Is that about Van Epps? ... he didn't know how many of you used the mic.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, they used to do that, they would show me off when the guitars first came out too.
Turn it over now for the second. Yeah. Is that about Van Epps? Well, Van Epps used to get up on the mic when he took solos or something like that,
when he made recordings and all, he didn't know how many of you used the mic. Rather than to have an amplifier.
